text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Ines Fujin invites me to visit
the
amusement park where she works
part-time, so I
drop by to see how she's
doing.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, kiddos, let's all give the hero of
the park,
Park Knight, a nice loud
welcome! On the count
of three—one,
two...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Park Kniiight!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Okay, let's try that one more
time! Park
Kniiight!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, give me a second, everyone! I'll
just go
check up on Park Knight's battle
status!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like something's going on
backstage...
Worried, I go over to check
the situation.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Th-the mascot actor suddenly got sick?!

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
He's currently cooped up in the restroom
with
stomachache... It doesn't look like
it'll last too
long, but could you buy us
some time until we can
sort this out?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Buy some time? I dunno... The only time
I ever go
on stage is to do my winning
concert dance
routine.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And that's a totally different livey-vibey
from a
superhero show. Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hold it right there! Is it true that Park
Knight is in
trouble?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! ...Wait, Biko?! And how come
you're here
too, Trainer?! This area's
off-limits to guests!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, it is an emergency, but—wait
a sec,
we really need to figure out the
stage situation!
Maybe we should just
tell everyone the truth
and—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It's Park Knight's duty as the hero of this

amusement park to bring joy to the
children,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Then we mustn't let the children down!
They've
come all the way here to cheer
for Park Knight!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Telling the truth would
only
disappoint the kids and their
parents.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I really don't want to make these families
sad on
their day out together. I might
not be a hero,
but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to put on an entertaining
performance for
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...But how? This isn't a winning concert,
so I'm not
sure how well my dance would
go down.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
A hero-style dance number... That could
be fun!
Biko, could you give me a hand?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Listen, everyone! We've got a situation!
Park
Knight's in a real crisis!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Urgh, it's all my fault... Park Knight got
captured
by the enemy leader to save
my life!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear that, everyone? You know
what this
means, right? We have to
cheer for Park Knight!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Let's all dance together! I'm sure the
power of
dance will help save Park
Knight!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You've got this, Park Knight!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You're super tough, Park Knight!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone, show me your
biggest smiles!
All your smiles will boost
Park Knight's power!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The hero show is a great success, with
Ines Fujin's
performance perfectly
covering for the park
mascot's absence.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
An Ines-style dance... Yeah. I practice all
the time
to make my fans smile! This
should be a piece of
cake!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, watch this, you two! Ines is taking
the
stage!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Attention, all guests. There has been a
slight
change of schedule today, but
please enjoy this
mini dance show!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, everyone! Park Knight will be
back in
action soon, but until then, let's
all sing and
dance together!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: One, two, three! One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...And then finish with a spin! Okay, got
that?
Now let's add some lyrics to this
dance!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: One, t-two, three, and turn... I did it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! That's perfect!
Okay, let's all
become dancing superstars and
give
Park Knight a big surprise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The hero show is a great success, with
Ines Fujin's
performance perfectly
covering for the park
mascot's absence.
